description: Traffic volumes on top 40 intersections in SA is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. A ranking of the top 40 intersections based on the number of vehicles passing through each intersection. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are intersection, road, traffic, vehicle. It offers 10 resource(s) in csv, docx. The portal shows 2026-02-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
